title: ioctl_set_iv / set_aad / set_tag: no check for finalized state
description: ioctl_set_iv(), ioctl_set_aad(), ioctl_set_tag(), and ioctl_get_tag() check that fd_type == OPERATION but do NOT check state->finalized or state->error. A caller can: INIT → SET_IV → write → FINALIZE → SET_IV again. The second SET_IV after finalize will call ops->set_iv() on a finalized session. Whether this is harmful depends on the provider, but the framework should reject these calls after finalize since the session is logically complete. Similarly, GET_TAG after the session is in error state will still call ops->get_tag(). The UAPI header says SET_IV 'Must be called after CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_INIT and before write(2)' and SET_AAD 'before write(2)' — so calling them after FINALIZE violates the documented preconditions. The framework should enforce this with -EINVAL. Trigger: INIT → SET_IV → write → FINALIZE → SET_IV (succeeds, modifies provider session state post-finalization) → session in undefined state.
